alterations.description: Former communists trained for many years in Marxism, told us how they had found a bigger idea that had transformed their lives. They all now working for inspired democracy with the same zeal on they used to have for the class war.
One of them, a miner from the German Ruhr, told us that the unity of the free world is more feared in Kremlin than the atom bomb.
After hearing what had happened in Miami, a former communist from Denmark told us, 'If America spoke with this voice, the communist world would change'.
